The sign of the porter VII is a Pocket-slot item created with level 99 Divination using 120 incandescent energy and 1 dragonstone necklace.
Signs of the porter do not work on all of the listed items when dropped by monsters, such as grimy herbs, which are transported when harvesting from a patch but not when dropped by a monster.

Ancient pages are items which are sometimes obtained when rummaging barbarian skeletons or as monster drops in the Ancient Cavern.
Duplicate pages may still be obtained before completion of My notes if rummaging skeletons.

Anniversary Adventurer Full Helm.x: The Anniversary Adventurer Full Helm is a head slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Anniversary Adventurer Bundle.

sc: Anointed Slayer Book is an off-hand magic weapon cosmetic override unlocked by completing level 31 of Hero Pass: Underworld.
The artisans' workshop respect enhancer is a reward enhancer that increases respect earned in the Artisans' Workshop.
When obtained, it is automatically converted into 200 charges within Wythien's enhancer management interface, where the effect can be toggled on or off.
The ice-dyed augmented Imperium core is a level 92 Magic weapon, created by using an augmentor on a Imperium core (Ice), or by using ice dye on an augmented imperium core.

sc: The Black Knight captain's gown is part of the Black Knight captain's armour, obtained during The Death of Chivalry.
It's obtained from the armour stand in the garden of Edgeville Monastery at the beginning of the quest.
The recipe to construct it is obtained by purchasing the Party Decoration Bundle.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 10 elder rune bars and an elder rune platebody + 1, requiring 5,000 progress to complete, granting a total of 10,000 Smithing experience.
Cadavaberry seeds may be bought from the Vinesweeper minigame for 5 points each, or pickpocketed from farmers.

The sketch is made by using a piece of charcoal on a sheet of papyrus while standing on the South side of the castle, at the north end of Meiyerditch, just a few step west from where Safalaan tells the player to sketch the castle.

Chaos Witch gloves.x: Chaos Witch gloves is a hands slot cosmetic override. It is unlocked by alongside the rest of the Chaos Witch outfit by completing the Conqueror of Chaos achievement.

sc: It is created by adding a clean tarromin to a vial of water then adding a shrunk ogleroot.
A Coalington's Ember is an item obtained during the 2023 Christmas event as a potential reward from opening White Christmas Presents.
If lost, it can be re-obtained by searching the dead guard slumped against the wall outside the Temple of Light.
It can also be re-obtained at May's Quest Caravan after putting 150 quest points into the Hub Track.

Compass rose is an Archaeological material that can be obtained through excavating material caches or various excavation sites, requiring level 77 Archaeology with the addition to the new Daemonheim Dig Site, among other various dig sites around RuneScape.
Crystal shards are a quest item that can be found when mining crystalline corruption in the quest-specific instance of Shifting Tombs during Pharaoh's Folly.
Doogle leaves are items bought from Xuan's Fresh Produce in New Varrock for 100 zemomarks each.

Drakewing Legs.x: Drakewing Legs is a legs slot cosmetic override that is part of the Drakewing set.

sc: The Easter carrot is a holiday reward that was originally obtained from the 2009 Easter event, received upon its completion.
Starting from the 2025 Easter event, it can also be bought from The Grand Eggs-change.
Ectogloves is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering inside Daemonheim.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Crafting skill.
Since 17 December 2014, it was no longer obtainable, and could be traded in for 10 coins each at Santa's head elf.
The entgallow shortbow is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Fletching skill.

s: One of Kerapac's hidden laboratories on Anachronia
sc: Explosive effigy (empty) is a reward from the Effigy Incubator activity.
Empty effigies can be made as part of the Effigy Incubator Distraction and Diversion, by incubating explosive effigy (uncharged) (made from enriched scrap metal).
The farmer's jacket is a reward from Cabbage Facepunch Bonanza and Garden of Kharid that boosts Farming experience by 1%.
The completed farmer's jacket was later added as a possible reward from Treasure Hunter.
They could be obtained by giving another player a Gift of Giving.
The Flourishing Fairy is an override available from Solomon's General Store.
It was made by combining a green charm with 141 spirit shards and a ruby harvest jar.

Spirit gems, which are dropped by all monsters that drop a single charm and could be received from the Squeal of Fortune, functioned similarly to runecrafting pouches and stored uncharged summoning pouches before an update.
The fresh crab claw is an occasional drop from crabs, which may be crafted into a crab claw with a chisel and 15 Crafting.
The full jug is a quest item found in The Fremennik Trials quest.
It is made by using the jug on the tap.
A full snake basket is obtained by using a snake charm along with a snake basket on a desert snake.

Furniture plans: Guthix altar.x: Furniture plans: Guthix altar are plans that can be obtained by unlocking all the other god altars. When learned, they unlock the Guthix altar as a craftable piece of furniture.

sc: The plans can be purchased from the Harvest Boon run by Reynold during the Halloween event for 10,000 Spooky tokens.
After which, they will automatically be learned and will not be received as an item.
Furniture plans: Medium gold pile is a furniture plan that is a possible reward from a hard reward casket.
It is created by using a baked cave potato with a cooked giant flatfish.
The Greater Fury ability codex can be obtained from killing Verak Lith.
It could be found in the crates in Diango's Workshop.
Green robe bottoms can be purchased at the Tree Gnome Stronghold from Rometti at his store, Fine Fashions.
It is rarely obtained by killing Hollowtoof, leader of the Goblin Raids.
It is dropped by Crawling Hands, Zombie Hands, and Skeletal Hands.
After the wishlist miniquest is completed you can no longer obtain this as a drop.
Hollyhock can be found in a supply cupboard in the Kitchen during Murder on the Border.
The House Drakan hood is tier 70 hybrid headwear obtained during The Lord of Vampyrium.

House of Chaos Mega Bundle.x: The House of Chaos Mega Bundle is a cosmetic override pack that can be purchased from the Marketplace for 1940 RuneCoins for free-to-play players and 1746 RuneCoins for members.

sc: The ikuchi orokami mask is an orokami mask that can be obtained from an oily orokami as a rare loot from either free-hand catching it or looting an oily orokami jar.
The Inverted Construction master skillcape token is an unlock token awarded to Fresh Start Accounts that reach virtual level 120 Construction during the Fresh Start Worlds gamemode.
The token can be traded, once, directly to another player (it is not available on the Grand Exchange).
The Inverted Summoning skillcape token is a unlock token awarded to Fresh Start Accounts that reach level 99 Summoning during the Fresh Start Worlds gamemode.
The token can be traded, once, directly to another player (it is not available on the Grand Exchange).
The outfit has also been available in the Yak Coin Shop for 6 Yak coins.

The item list is a quest item a player can obtain during and after the quest Mourning's End Part II.
The exact ticket, book, and key needed can be found in the item list when read, and the other six items which are not required will be omitted.
All of these books can be obtained from the bookcases in your house.

The pouch is a possible reward from any level Treasure Trails, and players cannot create it on their own.
It has companion summoning scrolls, Meerkat scrolls (Fetch Casket), that are also obtained from Treasure Trails.
It is found by using a knife on a fireplace in a building near the centre of Meiyerditch after giving Safalaan three sketches of the Castle Drakan in the north part of town.
In addition, it suggests that the Vyrewatch might not be a race itself, but created from another race.

sc: A mind helmet can be made during and after the quest Elemental Workshop II from a mind bar on the workbench on level 1 of the Elemental Workshop.

The lamp is obtained upon logging in.
They can be obtained by looting magpie implings, bird's nests, from the Vinesweeper minigame for 10,000 points, hunting certain Big Game Hunter creatures, or killing aquanites.

Runecrafting XP lamp is a reward item given upon completion of the Rune Mythos quest.
Like all sacred clay items, it can be traded freely between players who are on the same team during the minigame.
Unlike other god books it is not purchased from Jossik, but instead it is obtainable as a drop from TzKal-Zuk in the TzekHaar Front, one of the four fronts in the Elder God Wars Dungeon.
A sedimentary geode is an openable item that can sometimes be obtained when mining copper, tin, iron, coal, mithril, adamantite, luminite, or runite rocks.
A shinigami orokami mask is an orokami mask that can be obtained from a murderous orokami as a rare loot from either free-hand catching it or looting a murderous orokami jar.

Silken top (green, female).x: The green silken top is part of the silken outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: To obtain skeletal bottoms either bring 2 dagannoth hides, 1 fibula piece and 7500 coins to Peer the Seer in Rellekka or trade with another player.
It can also be given as a reward for completing a farming request from Rhazien.
The skull mask is a reward for the temporary holiday event Festival of the Dead.
It is given to the player by Father Joakim after commemorating at least one deceased NPC.

Skullhide Stalker Bow.x: The Skullhide Stalker Bow is a two-handed ranged weapon cosmetic override that can be obtained by purchasing the Skullhide Stalker Bundle or Skullhide Stalker Weapon Bundle.

Sunglasses (yellow).x: The yellow version of sunglasses was introduced on 2 February 2015. They became available from the rare token store, and later from Treasure Hunter. If put into a keepsake box, a replica of the sunglasses is created, thus still allowing the player to switch between colours.

sc: Superior knowledge bombs are ultra-rare Treasure Hunter reward items, originally won in boxes of 10.

An uncut diamond can be crafted into a diamond, requiring level 43 Crafting and yielding 107.

Uncut diamonds can be obtained from sedimentary and igneous geodes, dropped as loot from defeating monsters, rewarded as a prize from many Distractions and Diversions, and mined from precious (with 43 Mining), rare (with 38 Mining) and Prifddinas gem rocks (75 Mining required to access).

Vagabond Knight's Longbow is a two-handed ranged weapon cosmetic override unlocked by completing tier 26 of the Expedition to the Wilderness Yak Track event while having access to premier rewards.
Vicendithas' Scribblings is a book found by searching the Dragonkin altar in the Edimmu resource dungeon.
Wingsuit v3 is an item that can be created by navigating the Stormguard Citadel Dig Site after first upgrading wingsuit v2 with two gravitron repulsors.
Since the wingsuit v2 can't be obtained outside the tool belt and it's automatically upgraded into v3 upon installing the gravitron repulsors, there is no way to obtain this item in the backpack.
The yellow balloon is created by using yellow dye on an origami balloon.

Zamorakian ceremonial robe bottom.x: The Zamorakian ceremonial robe bottoms is an item that could be obtained by redeeming 250 Astromancer credits.
